CustomField.description: DIR-869: Set true by the "Submit for Discount Approval" screen flow when the RM/Specialist explicitly submits. This, not a raw Discount/Status change, is what launches the DOA orchestration. Reset to false by the orchestration's own first step (flagged via RES_System_Status_Update__c) so the next submission can re-trigger it. Not exposed to users directly - only the submission screen flow sets it.
CustomField.label: Discount Submission Requested
